about: Horns for the last refrain of Jingle Bells' felt piano (version 8, after 7c: "one more colour of instrument"), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the piano and 7c's strings, each as its own instrument: bars 52-67, up to two notes at a time, held (starting under twice a bar), loosely between D3 and F4, in the middle under the strings' top.
